images.product: Genova Solid White / Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil, 5 oz can (Tri-Union Seafoods / Chicken of the Sea)
images.shows: bottom of can, lot/date panel fully legible: 'S88N  BEST IF USED BY 1/17/28 D1M'. This is the exact style of code panel the F-0610-2025 recall lists (lot S88ND1M, best by 01/17/2028). No UPC barcode, no brand text in frame. Photo published on the January 2026 FDA announcement for the follow-on release of quarantined stock from the same February 2025 easy-open-lid recall event; it is the same firm, brand and code format, not a separate photo attached to the F-0610-2025 record itself.
